page: Amazon Web Services i3en.2xlarge is a storage-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8259CL processor with x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. This instance provides 8 vCPUs across 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of DDR4 memory running at 3 GHz, translating to 8.0 GB of RAM per core. A key hardware feature is the inclusion of 5000 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, alongside a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the i3en.2xlarge delivers average multi-core CPU and memory performance. Stress-ng multi-core CPU tests, Passmark CPU scores, and memory bandwidth tests consistently fall into the average category. However, single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores. Cryptographic and database operations, such as Redis SET operations and Passmark database tests, perform at an average level, while LLM inference speeds are weak to poor.

Given its high storage-to-compute ratio, the i3en.2xlarge offers strong qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring massive local storage capacity without needing top-tier compute performance. The combination of 5000 GB NVMe SSD storage and 64.0 GB of RAM makes this instance highly suitable for NoSQL databases, transactional databases, distributed file systems, and data warehousing applications that benefit from low-latency local storage.
